rapport_notes: Pleasant and thorough, patiently clarified which rooms were and weren't being moved (partial-apartment move).

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any concern about the moving process aside from the pricing? Do you have any questions?" - asked near the end of discovery, right before pricing
